title: 第25章 恐怖的欺人之谈上第26章 恐怖的欺人之谈下
slug: 异世界开局俘虏女骑士
lines: 第二天一大早天边刚泛起一点鱼肚白，杨静就独自一人出发了，她要赶去康斯顿城确认那个情报的真实性。
如果情报属实，那队伍能一次性解决资金匮乏和人才稀少这两项问题。
从风桃村到康斯顿城有三十多公里的路程，就算以刺客大师的脚程来回一趟也要一天的时间，为了能够在今天之内赶回来，杨静起的特别早。
当齐格飞从床上爬起来的时候，杨静已经走了快三个小时了。
从昨天开始，他就把自己的农活全部丢给了手下那些吃白饭的士兵了，空下了不少时间去做其他的事。
“早安，梅兰大人。”
黄毛士兵莱姆恭恭敬敬地向走出屋子的齐格飞行了个礼，今天他临时担任齐格飞的护卫。虽然莱姆完全不觉得这位恐怖的大人需要什么护卫。
齐格飞瞥了他一眼，不咸不淡道：
“早啊，伤好的差不多了？”
莱姆一愣，立刻低下了头恭敬道：“是的，多亏村民们的照顾。”
袭击村庄事件中，莱姆受的伤仅次于卡塔丽娜。
不过那个小虎妞身体比牛还壮实，齐格飞给她上点药第二天就能活蹦乱跳了。
而莱姆就没这么好运了，牧师拒绝为他疗伤，这哥们在床上躺了两天，吃喝都是村民的负责递送的，其中还有之前差点被他殴打的小托娃。
齐格飞有些坏心眼故意嘲笑道：“哦？现在是村民不是贱民了？”
莱姆羞愧地满面通红，头都要埋到脖子里去了：”属下该死，属下……”
“行了，你只要记住，就是这些你看不上的贱民救了你的命。“
“是！属下牢记在心！”
”说吧，有什么事？“
莱姆从怀中拿出一张羊皮纸，递给了齐格飞说道：
“这是昨天伏击的战利品和俘虏清单，请大人过目。”
羊皮纸上的字迹清秀端正，一看就知道是那位王女殿下的笔迹。
齐格飞拿过清单，不由得眉头一挑。
长矛、直剑、铠甲之类的普通装备有将近一百套，甚至还有几件魔法武器以及不少军粮。
（收获颇丰啊，看来是打掉了一支精锐，真亏罗兰能不损一兵地把他们全歼了。）
“把战利品分类放进仓库做好记录。”
“是！……大人那些俘虏要怎么安排呢？”
除了装备和粮食，罗兰还抓了七个俘虏回来，其中一个领头的大骑士是齐格飞特意叮嘱的，要留活口。剩下的那些大概是幸存者。
齐格飞思索了一阵，突然露出了一个阴狠的笑容。
“大骑士留下，其余人，全部坑杀！“
“什么！”
莱姆腿一软，差点摔在地上。
他有听说过历史上有那么几位勇者极度嗜杀，属于打到哪哪里就血流成河的凶神，比魔王还像魔王。但他没想到眼前这位居然连俘虏都不放过。
莱姆后背渗出了一层冷汗，他立刻单膝下跪，急迫地恳求道：
“大人，他们都已经没有抵抗能力了，杀俘不仅会让大家害怕，还会损害您在士兵们心中的形象，殿下也不会同意这样的做法，还望您三思。“
齐格飞当然不会真的杀俘，他单纯就是想念一下这句台词，顺便吓吓这个大头兵。
（以前就觉得全部坑杀这四个字非常霸气，亲口说出来的感觉果然不一样。）
狠狠燃烧了一把中二之魂后，齐格飞看了一眼跪在瑟瑟发抖的莱姆，强忍着笑意正色道：
“行了行了，我和你开玩笑呢，瞧你那熊样。那个大骑士关在哪，带我去。”
莱姆长舒一口气，发自内心地希望这位大人最好一辈子都不要开玩笑了。
content_en:
Early the next morning, as soon as a little white fish belly appeared on the horizon, Yang Jing set out alone. She wanted to rush to Constant City to confirm the authenticity of the information.
If the intelligence is true, then the team can solve the two problems of lack of funds and scarce talent at once.
There is a distance of more than 30 kilometers from Fengtao Village to Constant City, and even a round trip at the pace of a master assassin would take a day. In order to be able to get back within today, Yang Jing got up very early.
When Siegfried got up from the bed, Yang Jing had been gone for almost three hours.
Since yesterday, he has left all his farm work to his free-loading soldiers, freeing up a lot of time to do other things.
"Good morning, Lord Meilan."
The yellow-haired soldier Lem bowed respectfully to Siegfried who walked out of the house. Today he temporarily served as Siegfried's bodyguard. Although Lime didn't think this terrifying adult needed any protection at all.
Siegfried glanced at him and said without saltiness:
"Good morning. Are you almost healed?"
Lime was stunned, then immediately lowered his head and said respectfully: "Yes, thanks to the care of the villagers."
During the attack on the village, Rhyme was injured second only to Katarina.
But the little tiger girl was stronger than an ox. Siegfried gave her some medicine and she would be alive and kicking the next day.
Lem was not so lucky. The priest refused to treat his injuries. The man lay in bed for two days. The villagers were responsible for delivering food and drink, including Little Towa, who was almost beaten by him before.
Siegfried was a little evil and deliberately laughed: "Oh? Now he is a villager and not a pariah?"
Lime's face turned red with shame, and his head almost buried in his neck: "This subordinate deserves to die, this subordinate..."
"Okay, just remember that it was these untouchables you looked down upon that saved your life."
"Yes! I will keep this in mind!"
"Tell me, what's the matter?"
Lem took out a piece of parchment from his arms, handed it to Siegfried and said:
"This is a list of the spoils and prisoners of yesterday's ambush. Please take a look, sir."
The handwriting on the parchment was clear and neat, and you could tell at a glance that it was the handwriting of Her Royal Highness.
Siegfried took the list and couldn't help but raise his eyebrows.
There are nearly a hundred sets of common equipment such as spears, straight swords, and armor, and there are even a few magic weapons and a lot of military rations.
(It was a great harvest. It seems that they killed an elite group. It’s a shame that Roland was able to wipe them all out without losing a single soldier.)
"Category the loot into the warehouse and keep records."
"Yes!... Sir, how will you arrange the prisoners?"
In addition to equipment and food, Roland also captured seven prisoners. One of the leading knights was specially ordered by Siegfried to stay alive. Those that remain are presumably survivors.
Siegfried thought for a while and suddenly showed a sinister smile.
"The great knight stays, the rest are trapped and killed!"
"What!"
Lime's legs weakened and he almost fell to the ground.
He had heard that there were a few brave men in history who were extremely bloodthirsty. They were ferocious gods who would bleed like rivers of blood wherever they hit them. They were more like the Demon King than the Demon King. But he didn't expect that the person in front of him would not even let go of the prisoners.
A layer of cold sweat broke out on Lime's back. He immediately knelt down on one knee and begged urgently:
"My lord, they are no longer able to resist. Killing prisoners will not only frighten everyone, but will also damage your image in the hearts of the soldiers. Your Highness will not agree to such an approach. I hope you will think twice."
Of course, Siegfried would not actually kill the prisoners. He simply missed this line and frightened the big-headed soldier.
(I used to think that the four words "kill them all" were very domineering, but the feeling was really different when I said it myself.)
After burning a handful of Chuuni Souls, Siegfried glanced at Lem who was kneeling and shivering, suppressed a smile and said sternly:
"Okay, okay, I'm kidding you, look at your bearish behavior. Where is the big knight, take me there."
Lime let out a long sigh of relief and hoped from the bottom of his heart that this adult would never make jokes again.
